predicate.label: reviews works in medium
predicate.definition: Person X critically reviews artistic works or editions presented in medium Y.
includes: explicit review of a collection, edition or version identified by the medium
historical critical review in the identified medium
excludes: review of a performer or venue alone
the publication carrying the review rather than the medium of the reviewed work
merely mentioning or producing the medium
ambiguous: unclear whether Y identifies the reviewed-work medium or the review publication
predicate.notes: This is a distinct argument relation from reviews_artistic_output_of. A DVD collection review can establish the medium even if the work title is omitted.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit review of a collection, edition or version identified by the medium; historical critical review in the identified medium. Excludes: review of a performer or venue alone; the publication carrying the review rather than the medium of the reviewed work; merely mentioning or producing the medium. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear whether Y identifies the reviewed-work medium or the review publication; missing critic or review attachment. This is a distinct argument relation from reviews_artistic_output_of. A DVD collection review can establish the medium even if the work title is omitted.

rationale: Artistic works/collections/releases reviewed in DVD medium form the largest family, separate from office/datelined reporting and seats.
